extraction_scope: Owner-worker source-reviewed mechanism ontology record from primary XML/PDF captions, methods, and supplementary text. Placeholder automated mechanism notes were replaced with source-located evidence classes.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: 8P9R cross-links SARS-CoV-2 virions into larger clusters, reducing viral entry/infectivity.
mechanism_claims.assay_type: transmission electron microscopy and virus binding/entry assays

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:The dual-functional activities of 8P9R against virus; xml:fig=2:Fig. 2a

supporting_observations: TEM caption reports 8P9R-treated SARS-CoV-2 clusters larger than usual virions and particle counts across representative microscope fields
Primary text contrasts 8P9R with P9R/P9RS controls for virus cross-linking
mechanism_claims.limitations: Directly supports cross-linking/entry-blocking mechanism; exact raw source-data spreadsheet was not present locally.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: 8P9R inhibits endosomal acidification, supporting reduced coronavirus entry through the endocytic pathway and synergy with arbidol.
mechanism_claims.assay_type: pHrodo red dextran endosomal acidification assay and antiviral combination assays

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:The dual-functional activities of 8P9R against virus; xml:sec=21:Endosomal acidification assay; xml:fig=2:Fig. 2c; xml:fig=3

supporting_observations: Primary text states 8P9R efficiently inhibited endosomal acidification similarly to bafilomycin A1
Combination figures/captions source-locate 8P9R plus arbidol antiviral synergy
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is source-supported for endosomal acidification; downstream clinical effect is outside AMP mechanism scope.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: 8P9R is presented as blocking SARS-CoV-2 entry in both endocytic and TMPRSS2-mediated surface pathways, with surface-pathway support coming from Calu-3 and spike/ACE2 fusion context rather than a direct peptide-enzyme inhibition claim.
mechanism_claims.assay_type: Calu-3/Vero-E6 infection comparisons, spike-ACE2 fusion assay, and western blot/TMPRSS2 digestion context

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=10:Simultaneous blockage of the two entry pathways; xml:sec=23:Western blot for TMPRSS2 digestion assay

supporting_observations: Primary text reports 8P9R inhibition in both Vero-E6 and Calu-3 cells
Methods describe TMPRSS2/S protein digestion context
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not overclaim direct TMPRSS2 enzymatic inhibition; source supports pathway-level entry blocking context.
